correctness.summary: Two explicit nonnegative fillings attain a+2b and 3(a+c)/2. Binary-tree reduction plus the tour half-perimeter bound and an exhaustive 105-tree six-leaf tour lemma give the matching lower bound; the constant-curvature chord profiles are analytically concave.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The 2012 source gives only an upper estimate for regular n-gons and an older open-problem list asks for regular-polygon fillings in Euclidean, spherical and Lobachevskii geometry. No located source states this two-branch six-point formula. The principal residual risk is arXiv:2607.27211, whose abstract was inspected but whose full text was not.

value.summary: The result makes the classical n=6 Euclidean regular-polygon estimate exact and simultaneously gives explicit spherical and hyperbolic regular-hexagon values through a curvature-uniform concave-profile theorem.

limitations: The abstract theorem assumes a nondecreasing concave cyclic chord profile.
The spherical corollary is restricted to 0<R<pi/2.
The exact minimum weight is determined, but all minimizing tree types are not classified.
The six-leaf combinatorial lemma is certified by exhaustive Python enumeration.
Originality is to the best of our knowledge; the full text of arXiv:2607.27211 was not inspected.
